notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
[p]Hi! As I mentioned earlier, I’ve just released a major [i]content update[/i]. There are [b]three new levels[/b] to explore, the [b]story continues[/b] with new developments, and I’ve also added many small improvements throughout the game. Additionally, the [b]combat system has been refined[/b] to make every fight feel more satisfying. I’d love for you to give it a try — I really hope you’ll enjoy what I’ve been working on![/p][p][/p][p]Stay in touch!
Anton Basan[/p][p][/p][p][b]P.S.[/b][/p][p]And as always, I will be very grateful for feedback on bugs found and general opinions about the game and its components. Your feedback helps me make this game better!

Discord server for feedback and just chatting: [url="https://discord.gg/nukpZqsY"]https://discord.gg/nukpZqsY[/url][/p]

tags.balance_change: - the combat system has been refined

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
[p]Hi, I'm happy to announce that I'm back in development! I'm currently releasing a small patch, but I'm already working on a larger [b]content update[/b] with [i]new levels[/i] and a continuation of the [i]story[/i]. I plan to finish it in the near future, so stay tuned![/p][p]At the moment, the following issues have been fixed:[/p][list][*][p]The player can get stuck in the Caves[/p][/*][*][p]The game freezes after dying with the Inventory open[/p][/*][*][p]Walking SFX is being played over the Dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]The Player is invincible after reaching 100% of the Rage stat[/p][/*][*][p]Quest Items cannot be picked up if the Inventory is full[/p][/*][*][p]Various Inventory UI bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Unrecognizable or too quiet SFX[/p][p]
Stay in touch!
Anton Basan[/p][/*][/list]
